title: The Poly-Olbion Project (Michael Drayton, Poly-Olbion)
author: Michael Drayton
notes: Full, unmodernised electronic copy of Drayton's 15,000-line topographical poem in the two parts published in 1612 and 1622 (songs 1-18 and 19-30), plus modernised extracts and a word list; John Selden's Illustrations are not included. All the text dates from 1450-1700. The site announces a forthcoming scholarly edition. Status: latest blog post is January 2019 but the site feed was rebuilt on 2024-04-11, so it is kept as active. No licence stated for the text; the CC BY-NC 3.0 mention on the home page concerns images. robots.txt blocks only /wp-admin/. The counts cover the thirty songs; the modernised extracts are not counted. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: No licence or copyright notice for the text on the home page, the-text, full-text Song 1 or about pages, or in the footer (only a privacy policy and image credits, e.g. a Folger map under CC BY-NC 3.0); checked 2026-10-13. The full-text transcription is unmodernised.
